audit.sourceQuery: best real estate in Toronto Canada

websiteDetails.title: Buy, Sell & Rent Homes in Toronto & Across Canada | Property.ca
websiteDetails.description: Buy, Sell & Rent Homes in Toronto & Across Canada. Search for sale, rent & sold properties, get live listings, sold prices, market data, and connect with expert local agents on Property.ca.

audit.summary: Property.ca is a Canadian real‑estate marketplace offering buy, sell, and rent listings across Toronto and Canada. It provides live MLS data, sold‑price histories, market reports, and connects users with local agents. The platform aims to simplify home searches with up‑to‑date listings and analytics.
audit.personalizationHook: Property.ca provides live Toronto listings and market data at a glance.

painPoints: Slow page load times affecting user experience
Need for modern UI/UX to improve engagement
Limited lead generation beyond basic sign‑up
Desire for more detailed analytics and market insights
websiteProblems: Excessive loading spinners indicate slow performance
Price history access requires login, limiting transparency
Limited featured listings displayed on the homepage
Generic CTA and lack of clear contact/about pages
Outdated UI design with minimal branding
growthOpportunities: Expand coverage beyond Toronto to other Canadian markets
Offer premium analytics dashboards for real‑estate agents
Add virtual tour & interactive map features
Develop a mobile app for on‑the‑go search
